x-k-k4-04.title: Bhuka ikamelo
x-k-k4-04.goal: Hlanganisa imithetho yekamelo evela esaziseni nomyalezo womngani weqembu bese uthola amacebo ahlukene amaningana okubhuka ahlangabezana nazo zonke izimo.

Iqembu lakho lifuna ukusebenzisa ikamelo ngemva kwesikole. Funda isaziso nomyalezo ovela kumngani weqembu u-서준.

- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.

x-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Ukufudumeza: u-서준 uphakamisa ukusebenzisa ikamelo kusuka ku-오후 2시 kuya ku-4시. Kungani lolu hlelo luhluleka?

x-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola amacebo ahlukene angu-3 okubhuka alandela isaziso nomyalezo ka-서준. s = ukuqala (오후 s시), h = amahora osebenzisa ikamelo.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umthetho ngamunye njengomkhawulo wehora lokuqala noma lokuphela.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ihora lokuqala, engeza ihora eli-1 noma amabili ayi-2, bese uhlola ihora lokuphela ngokumelene nesikhathi sokuhlanza.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.2: Ngemva kokuthola uhlelo, shintsha ubude kuphela bese uhlola futhi.

x-k-k4-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Ikamelo livuliwe kuze kube ngu-6 o'clock kuphela.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: Amacebo amane ayasebenza: 오후 2시~3시, 4시~5시, 4시~6시 no-5시~6시. Uhlelo luyahluleka uma luqala ngaphambi kuka-2, lugijima ngemva kuka-6, lusebenzisa amahora angu-3, noma luthinta u-3시~4시.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha UHLELO LUNYE lwakho bese uthumela u-서준 umyalezo omfushane wesiKorea usho ukuthi uzosebenzisa ikamelo nini.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa isikhathi esisodwa sokuqala nesisodwa sokuphela ohlwini lwakho.
x-k-k4-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sebenzisa u-~부터 ~까지 ukusho kusuka nini kuze kube nini.

x-k-k4-04.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Uhlelo lwehora elilodwa ngaphambi kokuhlanza; ucela ngenhlonipho.
